summary: charge_confusion_rate.py template mode reported status ok, and passed on in sign_rates, a charge-confusion rate that the fit does not identify, when the background template is degenerate with the right-sign template.

observables: template-mode status and sign_rates of bins with a background template
species_response.py from-rates manifests built from those sign_rates
impact.bias: the rate is an arbitrary point of a flat likelihood direction (e.g. injected 0.02: 0.021 or 0.023 with interval [0.019, 1.0], or 1.0 with interval [0.12, 1.0]) labelled ok
impact.trigger: template mode with a background template whose shape is close to the right-sign template's; an interval_68 reaching 1 is the signature

outputs.how_to_recognize: JSON on stdout of charge_confusion_rate.py template with a background template in a bin: interval_68 upper end 1.0 or a background shape compatible with the right-sign one, with status ok; no artifact records the run

remedy: rerun on a version with the fix; drop sign_rates entries of bins it marks not identified, and any species_response.py manifest built from them
